title: A Ghost for the Border
author: Ivo Lockridge
blurb: Silas Delacroix, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
